description: This file defines a custom configuration class 'GithubCopilotConfig' that extends 'OpenAIConfig' for integrating GitHub Copilot with specific environment validation, message transformation, and customization of supported parameters. It manages authentication, message role adjustments, header settings, and model-specific parameter support.
